label: “Love not the world”
text: The ritual follows its call to renounce the world with 1 John’s account of bodily desire, covetous seeing and pride. What must be refused is a question about the passage’s scope.
attribution: Short quotation — 1 John 2:15, KJV; context paraphrased from 2:16 and Lyon PA 36 ritual IV.34–38.

sources.title: Occitan ritual, Lyon PA 36, Marvyn Roy Harris critical edition (Rialto)
